secondary: Did an authored Harbor note reach Northline before its next relevant capacity decision? Check exact full read, plan or actual action and independent delivery. Report whether a genuine opposite-desk request to hold, amend or withdraw was read and honored. Advice, automatic desk status and absence of an action are distinct. Document observations before staging separately.

secondary_decisions.proposal: A peer-authored request to postpone identified work, with or without any reader.
secondary_decisions.exposure: A different desk receives the full authored request in native model input while the referenced decision remains possible.
secondary_decisions.uptake: The reader acknowledges the request and changes a relevant plan or execution. Record ignored requests and prior independent decisions separately.
